answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can vouch for others, and slash that stake if a vouched newcomer cheats. One identity can sit on the knoll and look harmless, but to forge a hundred sockpuppets an attacker must lock a hundred stakes, so the cost scales linearly with the size of the attack. Peers only trust attestations from agents whose stake is on the line, and a violet flag marks any agent whose vouches keep failing - its stake burns first, so spinning up fake identities stops being cheap.
